tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Live roles at early-stage startups, posted by their founders and checked by hand, newest first. Filter by function, engineering sub-category, funding stage, remote and location.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: One role in full by its slug (from search_jobs or the role URL): title, company, location, pay and equity when stated, funding stage, the founder’s original post and who wrote it.

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: A company by its slug: what it does, website and X account, funding stage, its open roles and its newest SEC Form D filings.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_job · Public sink: get_job.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_job · Public sink: get_job

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
